title: ImportLint configuration
description: Configuration for the import-lint TypeScript/JavaScript linter.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema used by the editor. ImportLint ignores this property.

include.description: Roots to walk for lint targets, relative to the project root.

exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from discovery, in addition to .gitignore.

tsconfig.description: Path to tsconfig.json, relative to the project root.

severity.description: Whether violations are errors, warnings, or disabled.

indexLoophole.description: Treat index files as belonging to their parent directory for package-boundary purposes.

filenameLoophole.description: Treat a file and the directory with the same name stem as belonging to the same package.

defaultImportability.description: Access level for exports without a recognized JSDoc access tag.

treatSelfReferenceAs.description: Whether imports through the project's own package name are checked.

excludeSourcePatterns.description: Glob patterns for exporting files that should never be checked.

nonTsFiles.description: Access levels for exports from non-TypeScript files, keyed by a file glob.

additionalProperties.description: Export name to access-level mapping. Use * for non-default exports.
